mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and potential recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate reverts to its previous level within 6 months, or S&P 500 returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive months of positive month-over-month growth, signals a strengthening supply-side recovery that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Industrial production growth decelerates or turns negative in the following month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 1 percentage point increase over the past 6 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate reverses course and declines by > 0.5pp within the next 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer sentiment, as measured by a 5% decline in real personal consumption expenditures over the past 3 months, signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer sentiment rebounds and RSAFS grows by > 3% in the following 3 months, or 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and slowing payroll growth, defined as UNRATE increasing by > 0.3pp and PAYEMS month-over-month growth falling below 100,000, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate declines and payroll growth accelerates in the following month, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts, defined as a 10% drop over the past 3 months, signals a weakening construction sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts rebound and grow by > 5% in the following 3 months, or 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in CPI inflation, defined as a 1 percentage point increase in the CPI year-over-year growth rate over the past 3 months, signals a potential overheating economy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation decelerates and the year-over-year growth rate declines by > 0.5pp in the following 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
